comment: Era buckets for the Pokémon Japan catalog (TCGCSV categoryId 85).
TCGCSV publishes 450 Japanese groups with no series field of their own,
so the /browse series header has to come from somewhere. It comes from
here rather than from a match arm in Rust (data-model-is-the-product).
Resolution: a group takes the series of the LAST era whose `from` date
is <= its release date. Groups TCGCSV publishes without a real release
date (their publishedOn is a same-day placeholder timestamp) fall to
`undated_series`. A `name_overrides` entry wins over the date rule when
a group's release date sits on the wrong side of an era boundary.
Era boundaries are the Japanese block starts, not the English ones —
Japan runs ~2-4 months ahead of the international release calendar.
